unit: 长难句：同位语从句和非限制性定语从句
subject: 英语

steps.title: 这句话
steps.md: The idea that people can change their habits overnight, which many self-help books promote, is not supported by research.

steps.title: 先找谓语
steps.md:
这句话里有三个动词短语：can change、promote、is not supported。整句的谓语只有一个，先找它。

```parse
id: ps-lg-1
title: 拆主干
q: 第 1 步只标整句的谓语；第 2 步标主语（主语带着的修饰全算进去）。
answer: [S The idea that people can change their habits overnight, which many self-help books promote], [V is not supported] by research.
roles: S V
steps: V | S
explain: can change 在 that 从句里，promote 在 which 从句里，都不是整句的谓语；整句谓语是 is not supported。主语是 The idea 连同后面两个从句。盖住两个从句，主干就是 The idea is not supported by research。
```

steps.title: 两个引导词
steps.md:
````frames
id: fr-lg-gap
title: that 和 which 占没占位置
q: 主语里有两个从句：① that people can change their habits overnight；② which many self-help books promote。
---
array 从句②: many self-help books promote *the *idea
> 先把从句②还原成普通的句子：promote 的宾语是 the idea。
---
array 从句②: many self-help books promote !which
> 用 which 代替 the idea。
---
?? 把 which 挪到从句开头，promote 后面空出来的是什么成分？ = 宾语 | 主语 | 什么也没空出来
array 从句②: *which many self-help books promote _
> which 在从句里作 promote 的宾语：从句②是**定语从句**（attributive clause），修饰 the idea。
---
?? 去掉 that，剩下的 people can change their habits overnight 缺不缺成分？ = 不缺，that 只起连接作用 | 缺主语 | 缺宾语
array 从句①: ~that people can change their habits overnight
> that 不作任何成分，后面是完整的句子，说的就是 idea 的内容：从句①是**同位语从句**（appositive clause）。
````

steps.title: 同位语还是定语
steps.md:
```recognize
id: rec-lg-1
title: 认从句
methods: 同位语从句 | 定语从句
reason: true
shuffle: true

item: The news **that our team had won** spread quickly.
answer: 同位语从句
why: 去掉 that，our team had won 完整；从句说的就是 news 的内容。

item: The news **that he brought us** was exciting.
answer: 定语从句
why: brought us 后面缺「带来的东西」，that 作 brought 的宾语。

item: The fact **that he lied** made her angry.
answer: 同位语从句
why: he lied 完整，that 不作成分，从句就是 fact 的内容。

item: The fact **that we learned in class** turned out to be useful.
answer: 定语从句
why: learned 缺宾语，that 作 learned 的宾语。

item: The suggestion **that he made** was rejected.
answer: 定语从句
why: made 缺宾语，that 作 made 的宾语。

item: The suggestion **that we should leave early** was rejected.
answer: 同位语从句
why: we should leave early 完整，说的是建议的内容。
```

steps.title: 按意群读
steps.md:
```chunk
id: ch-lg-1
title: 切成意群
text: The idea / that people can change their habits overnight, / which many self-help books promote, / is not supported | by research.
translate: on
explain: 中心词 the idea 一个意群；同位语从句一个；定语从句一个；谓语带 by research 一个。翻译时按意群往下顺：「人能一夜之间改掉习惯，这种说法很多励志书都在推，但研究并不支持。」
```

steps.title: 换一句自己拆
steps.md:
```parse
id: ps-lg-2
title: 新句子
q: 第 1 步标谓语；第 2 步标主语；第 3 步标出主语里的两个从句。
answer: [S The belief [AppC that money can buy happiness], [RC which many young people hold]], [V has been challenged] by recent studies.
roles: S V AppC RC
steps: V | S | AppC RC
explain: 谓语 has been challenged；主语 The belief 带两个从句：that money can buy happiness 完整，是 belief 的内容（同位语从句）；which 作 hold 的宾语，修饰 the belief（定语从句）。
```
